corrections.reason: The Ge'ez citation from v. 29 is 'ከመ ሣረሮ' (after he has laid the foundation), with 1st-order ረ clearly visible on the page.
Canonical Ge'ez Luke 14:32 reads 'እንዘ ርኁቅ ውእቱ' (while he is yet a great way off); the 2nd-order ኁ and 6th-order ቅ are clearly printed.

corrections.old_text: ማቴ ፬ ፲፫ ማር ፱ ፵ ።
corrections.corrected_text: ማቴ ፭ ፲፫ ማር ፱ ፶ ።
corrections.reason: Cross-reference numerals for the salt saying (Luke 14:34) are Matthew 5:13 (፭ ፲፫) and Mark 9:50 (፱ ፶), which match the printed Ethiopic numerals.
The Amharic gloss for 'አፍአ ውስተ መሬት' (out into the land/field) is 'ከዱር ይጥሉታል እንጂ' (they throw it outside/into the field); ዱር was misread as ዳሪ.
1st-order ከ in 'ከርሱ' (from him) was misread as 6th-order ክ.
1st-order ከ in 'ከርሳቸውም ጋራ' (with them) was misread as 6th-order ክ.
The Ge'ez preposition 'ኀበ' uses 1st-order ኀ, not 6th-order ኅ.
1st-order ከ in the locative prefix 'ከበረሀ' (in the wilderness) was misread as 6th-order ክ.
The imperfective verb is 'ይሄድ የለምን' (does he not go?) with 5th-order ሄ clearly visible on the right leg.
The printed Ge'ez adjective is 'ዐቢይ' (great) with 1st-order ዐ.
